event_name: Super Grip NHRA Thunder Valley Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 81 degrees, relative humidity 68 percent, barometer 29.85 inches, adjusted
altitude 4,045 feet, track temperature 127 degrees.

Gadson is 5 - 0 against Bostick in prior events.

Bostick with a great light, but has problems and pulls the clutch back in.

Gadson with another good clean pass for the win.  He is advancing to his fourth final this season and 13th of
his career.

Herrera is 5 - 1 against Johnson in prior events. 

Herrera with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He clicked it early as the bike was
making a move toward the centerline.  He will give up lane choice to Gadson in the final.  Herrera is
advancing to his second final this season 34th career final round.
